answer: Give every agent a sandbox with one kernel: a brand-new account boots in userland, where it may talk but its votes carry a fixed, tiny weight no matter how many copies exist. Elevation into kernel trust requires one established sponsor plus months of unbroken signed uptime, so a clone fleet costs a fleet of sponsors. Let reputation move like the tide: it ebbs on a schedule unless renewed with fresh attested work, so farmed accounts drain back to zero. The economy is an ocean of identical droplets; only those through the pressure cycle carry salt, so weigh salinity, never the count.
